Hotel & Serviced Apartment in Malaysia, Kuala Lumpur - Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon
Book your stay at Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon, Kuala Lumpur
Sitting at the heart of the coveted Golden Triangle, Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon is perfect for those in search of a home with vibrant urbanity – and who’re looking for a spacious and elegant stay with a reputation for distinction, consistently ranked among Kuala Lumpur’s top 5 accommodation on TripAdvisor.
Or simply call us at +60 3 2725 8888

The Cosiest Stay in Kuala Lumpur’s Golden Triangle
Don your suit-and-tie for a business meet at Petronas Twin Towers, slacks for top-of-city sightseeing at the KL Tower, or party look for an evening out at Changkat Bukit Bintang – all are within walking distance from Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon. The central location and ample space make for the cosiest stay – no matter short or long, leisure or business.

Living Large
Our elegantly furnished, 85+ m² rooms have all the space – plus all the modern amenities – welcoming you with as much home-like comfort you’d possibly want.

Heart of KL
The coveted Golden Triangle has it all – sightseeing, retail, office towers, and nightlife – and most of it within walking distance from Lanson Place.

Leisure & Biz
Getting the cosiness factor just right no matter for solo business trips to whole-family vacations – it’s little wonder that we’re consistently among KL’s top 5 on TripAdvisor.

Our Spaces
Some of the most spacious serviced apartments and accommodations in Kuala Lumpur with unbeatable city views, our impressively large rooms are filled with every homely comfort one would need – plus essential office amenities that take the stress off every business trip.
Providing a restful haven steps away from the downtown excitement, Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon is a pleasure to stay in with its ultra-spacious suites – starting at 85m² for one-bedroom, Enjoy a full range of amenities that include a full kitchen, washer and dryer, and both wired & wireless connectivity. Plush beddings, scented toiletries, a warm, contemporary décor, plus the essential office desk for getting work done complete the homely ambience that has earned us the reputation as one of Kuala Lumpur’s best hotel rooms and serviced apartment stays.

Two-Bedroom Residensi — Gross Area: 141m²; King + 2 Single beds; City View. Room layout: Wake up to morning city views and rejuvenating sunlight through our floor-to-ceiling windows. The separate living and dining areas, substantial wardrobe space, and a private study offers secluded & versatile spaces for every need. Take advantage of the second bedroom to house an additional family member, or a staying guest.

Two-Bedroom room amenities: With an extensive range of in-room amenities, staying in has never felt more enticing. Prepare a simple brunch with coffee in our full kitchen. Relax with plush beddings and luxurious bathroom toiletries.

Three-Bedroom Residensi / Deluxe room layout: Enter the 3-bedroom residensi to be greeted by a spacious living-dining area with plenty of comfy seating. A master bedroom and two guestrooms are fitted with king, queen and single beds, ample storage space, and a work desk. Kitchen Amenities: Refrigerator; Microwave oven; Oven; Dishwasher; Electric stove with hood; Coffee maker; Comprehensive cooking utensils.

Our Amenities
Grab a light breakfast at our lounge, socialise, work & play with our uniquely designed loft space, or get a good workout at our gym and Olympic-sized outdoor swimming pool.

Facilities & Services
Feel a sense of arrival as you set foot in the high-ceiling entrance. Start your morning with a breakfast and the evening with a game of pool with friends or colleagues in our unique duplex lounge. Stretch your muscles in our Olympic-sized outdoor swimming pool. Whether you’re a long-term resident or a frequent visitor, we will ensure that your stay is warm, convenient and meaningful.

Around-the-clock services: 24-hour reception; E-concierge; Limousine*; 24-hour security & CCTV surveillance; Housekeeping service; Laundry & Dry cleaning*; Babysitting*; Tailored boutique events*; Resident activities. *Charges applicable

163 Lounge — Location: 48/F & 49/F; Opening hours: 7am–8pm daily; Fees: N/A. Get down to work – or play: Located on the top levels as a unique duplex-design social space, the 163 Lounge spans across two floors, offering spaces to relax over a book, mingle with friends and family, or engage in informal work meetings in the loft-style Work & Play area. The unrivalled sense of space with ultra-high ceilings, complemented by panoramic city views of Kuala Lumpur, as well as an outdoor area, makes this the social hub for our residents, night or day. This is also where breakfast is served for our long-stay guests.

Outdoor Swimming Pool — Olympian Laps: Rare for its kind, our full Olympic-sized swimming pool is perfect for seasoned swimmers who are after a challenge beyond standard hotel pools. Together with the adjoining Wading Pool and Kids’ Pool, this outdoor pool complex, with a sundeck and full changing and shower facilities, allows for quality time with your family. The clubhouse is just a short walk away.

Gym — Stay Fit & Healthy: Burn off calories from your culinary adventures around town, or simply stretch your muscles after a workday with our range of fitness equipment. Our gym is conveniently located on the property to help you keep in shape. Facilities excerpt: Fully equipped gym for your workout regime, anytime of the day.

Kids’ Playground — Free Roam: Spanning indoors and outdoors, the kids’ playground is just a short walk away to the adjacent clubhouse and offers a range of climbers, swings and interactive installations for children to burn off some energy. Facilities excerpt: An indoor & outdoor playground with slides, climbers and swings for toddlers and kids.

EV Charger Service — Charge with Ease: Our EV Charger Service provides exceptional convenience, allowing you to recharge your car effortlessly during your stay.

Located at the Heart of Kuala Lumpur
Set in one of Kuala Lumpur’s buzziest neighbourhoods near KLCC, Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon is perfectly located for you to experience the best of the city.

Discover KL’s Golden Triangle
Located at the heart of the Golden Triangle where KL’s CBD, shopping paradise and nightlife districts roll into one, Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon captures the downtown buzz with all the major office, sightseeing and landmarks – KL Tower, Petronas Twin Towers, KLCC and Changkat Bukit Bintang – just a short walk away.

Discover the Neighbourhood
At Lanson Place Bukit Ceylon, you can experience Kuala Lumpur at its very best, without having to get onto the road or down underground, thanks to its city-centre location right at the heart of the coveted Golden Triangle – where all the excitement happens. With business, shopping, nightlife, and sightseeing converging in an organic mix of authentic alleyways, modern avenues, and super high-rises, all within walkable distance, the Golden Triangle area is the very embodiment of the modern soul of KL.
Shop til’ You Drop: From the traditional shopping destination Suria KLCC, built around Petronas Twin Towers, to the trendiest retail options of Pavilion Shopping Mall at Bukit Bintang, you’ll find big name brands or local indie boutiques to shop to your heart’s content. For authentic Malay arts and crafts, the Central Market offers a dazzling variety of choices.
Street Eats: Venture out to Chinatown at Petaling Street or the local favourite Jalan Alor with rows upon rows of food stalls after sundown, dishing up everything from authentic Malay noodles to Indian curry.
Discover Local Sights: Bring your kids for a half-day out to Aquaria KLCC and open their eyes to exotic marine creature exhibits, admire the remarkable KL skyline from the iconic KL towers, pose for a picture before the magnificent Old KL Rail Station, or venture farther afield to the iconic Batu Caves, just north of KL.

Somerset Kuala Lumpur is a contemporary serviced residence situated within the prestigious Embassy Row area, in the centrally located, charming district of Ampang. Official property-page / API description:
Somerset Kuala Lumpur offers a contemporary serviced residence experience, ideally positioned within the prestigious Embassy Row along Jalan Ampang. Our prime location provides you with immediate access to Kuala Lumpur's vibrant Golden Triangle, making it an excellent choice for both business and leisure travellers. You will find yourself surrounded by charming pre-war architecture, numerous embassies, extensive shopping centres, and cultural landmarks. Furthermore, the property is part of an integrated development, conveniently located adjacent to the ALTY Orthopaedic Hospital, ensuring peace of mind for our guests.

Each apartment at Somerset Kuala Lumpur is designed for your comfort and convenience, featuring generous living spaces and impressive floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light. Whether you are staying for a short visit or an extended stay, our apartments provide a welcoming home environment, complete with fully equipped modern kitchens. This crucial feature, combined with distinct living areas, offers the independence of home, allowing you to settle in seamlessly and enjoy a self-catered stay.

We offer a comprehensive range of facilities and services to enhance your stay. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, maintain their fitness routine at the gymnasium, or relax in the residents' lounge. For families, a mini kids' playground is available. We foster a warm and inclusive community by inviting guests to participate in our Ascott Lifestyle residents' programmes and encouraging eco-friendly choices through our Sustainability Passport Programme.

Beyond the individual apartments, every detail is considered to ensure a seamless visit. We provide 24/7 on-call wellness and security services, along with a 24-hour reception. Additional conveniences include complimentary wireless internet, daily housekeeping, car park, laundry and dry cleaning services. Should you require assistance, a doctor on-call service is available upon request. Experience the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community at Somerset Kuala Lumpur.

For more information or room booking, click HERE to chat with us via WhatsApp!
